premises.text: Digital media creation for games and film is still almost entirely manual, driving very high time and cost
premises.evidence_span: it's still an almost entirely manual process

premises.text: Example-based AI (artematics) generates new artistic content from examples while keeping the artist in the loop for control
premises.evidence_span: Artematics is an example-based way of making art

premises.text: The system works across artistic data types including images and 3D models, inventing new variants rather than only remixing
premises.evidence_span: It can work on any kind of artistic data

premises.text: Video games are the beachhead market, with Artomatix Cloud extending to the broader industry
premises.evidence_span: we've identified that video games are our beachhead

premises.text: Monetization is through a software-as-a-service business model
premises.evidence_span: We're going to monetize through a software-as-a-service business model

value.text: Halve the time and cost of digital media creation through automation
value.evidence_span: half the time and half the cost of this process through automation

secondary_value.text: Automate tedious art tasks artists do not want to do
secondary_value.evidence_span: We automate the kind of work they don't want to do

secondary_value.text: Enable vastly richer, more varied digital worlds
secondary_value.evidence_span: We can take gaming to the next level

causal_links.evidence_span: art costs too much and it takes too long
artificial intelligence system that can mimic human-like artistic creativity
Artomatix Cloud, which can address the entire industry

notes: Patents/trade secrets folded into the AI capability premise per v1.3.2 §4.1(5). 'Future of art' closing treated as vision, not a premise. Traction (NVIDIA win, AAA franchise, acquisition offer) and founder bios excluded. Need/product/money triad justified: SaaS and beachhead are revisable without changing the generative engine.
